summary: Add an official stateless OpenAI Responses provider with bounded input conversion, typed-output normalization, frozen protocol identity and safe terminal failures while preserving every existing provider and feature.
decision_refs: The user selected advanced models as the reference analyst and CIRP as the local management, evidence-selection, validation and review layer
Official OpenAI Responses documentation defines POST /responses, store=false, text.format and typed output items
Existing Chat Completions payload and task identities must remain unchanged because this is an additive feature
approval_evidence: The user instructed continued implementation of the new Reference framework without deleting existing features.
known_limitations: No live OpenAI request was made, so model availability, account access, pricing and provider-side acceptance are unverified.
The fixed Reference question set was not rerun; no answer-quality or release-gate improvement is claimed.
OpenAI Responses remains user-selected and never becomes an automatic router, fallback or retry target.
